title: Kushilevitz–Mansour learning program
statement: For a dimension $n$, a rational learning parameter $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$, and a positive integer $M$, the program first runs the Goldreich–Levin query program with threshold $\varepsilon/(4M)$, then uses its resulting query state to run the second-stage sparse Fourier learner with parameters $\varepsilon$ and $M$.
caveat: The supplied descriptions do not define the Goldreich–Levin query program or its interaction with the second-stage learner.
